teams.detail: Jedd Fisch remains in a quiet recruiting stretch while calling plays himself after OC Jimmie Dougherty's departure; 4-star WR commit Tre Moore (Pflugerville, TX) has been drawing buzz at summer 7v7 events. Season opens Sunday, Sept. 6 vs. Washington State (1 p.m. PT, NBC) at Husky Stadium.

Danny Sprinkle remains on hot-seat watch after a 16-17 (7-13 Big Ten) finish; no fresh update on transfer target Boris Tisma or recruit Jaylen Petty this week. Center Hannes Steinbach was picked 14th overall by Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft.

Rookies reported to training camp today, first in the league to do so; veterans arrive Friday with nine public practices running July 25-Aug. 13. Seattle signed CB Brandon Johnson to bolster a banged-up secondary, and safety Nick Emmanwori (PUP list, not considered serious) can return anytime. NFL owners vote on the Khosla family's $9.612B purchase Aug. 26.

Restricted free agent center Jalen Duren remains unsigned three-plus weeks into the market, with conflicting reports on whether talks have gained momentum or stalled over a potential 25%-max deal; he could otherwise play 2026-27 on a $9.6M qualifying offer. Detroit finished 60-22 last season (East's No. 1 seed) before falling to Cleveland in the conference semis.

Cincinnati beat Seattle 4-2 Tuesday - Eugenio Suarez homered against his former team and Chase Burns threw 5 scoreless innings, snapping the Mariners' 3-game win streak; Weston Wilson and Julio Rodriguez (15th HR) went deep late but it wasn't enough. Seattle (51-51) hosts the series finale today, 12:40 p.m. PT at T-Mobile Park (Hancock vs. Singer).

headlines.headline: Golden State wins Summer League title as rookie Yaxel Lendeborg takes home MVP
headlines.detail: The Warriors beat the Grizzlies 94-90 in the Las Vegas Summer League championship, with rookie Yaxel Lendeborg outdueling Grizzlies rookie Cameron Boozer with 21 points, 10 rebounds, 2 assists, and 2 steals in 23 minutes to claim Summer League MVP.

headlines.headline: Cardinals guard Isaiah Adams faces four weapons charges but reports to training camp
headlines.detail: Arizona lineman Isaiah Adams, a 2024 third-round pick who started 11 games last season, turned himself in over the weekend on four charges - including possessing a restricted firearm without a license - stemming from a Canadian 'guns and gangs' investigation, and is still expected to report to camp Wednesday as all 32 NFL teams open camp by July 28.

headlines.headline: SEC Media Days Day Three: Ole Miss's Pete Golding and QB Trinidad Chambliss take the Tampa stage
headlines.detail: First-year Ole Miss coach Pete Golding, who replaced Lane Kiffin after his move to LSU, headlined Wednesday's session alongside preseason Heisman contender QB Trinidad Chambliss, RB Kewan Lacy, and DT Will Echoles, with Kiffin's own LSU debut and Arch Manning's Texas spotlight still ahead on Thursday.

headlines.headline: Michigan's offseason turmoil continues as AD Warde Manuel's step-down still reverberates
headlines.detail: Athletic director Warde Manuel's decision to step down at year-end following an independent Jenner & Block review remains the biggest storyline in men's college basketball as the sport sits in its deepest offseason lull; Manuel's staff already converted interim coach Mike Boynton Jr. into the permanent head coach on a two-year deal after national champion Dusty May left for the Dallas Mavericks' head job in late June.
